opening_hook: Kya aap bhi alarm ko ignore karte ho? Dekhiye Rohan ki kahani!
narration: Rohan ek chhota sa clerk tha jo har roz alarm ko snooze karta tha. Ek subah, usne socha ki bas aaj se discipline ki practice shuru karega. Usne apna alarm 5 baje set kiya aur pehle din sirf 5 minute walk ki. Roz ki thakan aur kaam ki pressure usko distract karne ki koshish ki, par Rohan ne apni routine ko todne nahi diya. Ek hafte baad, uski productivity double ho gayi aur uska manager uski punctuality ki tareef karne laga. Yeh choti jeet usko yaad dilati hai ki consistency se bade goals bhi achievable hote hain. Ab Rohan har din ek choti jeet celebrate karta hai, aur aap bhi kar sakte ho.
story_beats: Hook: Rohan, a clerk, habitually snoozes his alarm, missing the start of his day.
Problem: He realizes his lack of discipline is hurting his productivity and career.
Conflict: Despite setting an early alarm and a small walk, fatigue and work pressure tempt him to quit.
Turning point: After a week of sticking to the routine, his productivity doubles and his manager praises his punctuality.
Resolution: The small victory reinforces Rohan’s belief that consistency yields big results, and he begins celebrating daily wins.
Closing message: Discipline is built from tiny steps—start today!
